result.summary: The screen mostly renders cleanly. One clear defect: in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery-time text overlaps the delivery-fee text, making both unreadable. Minor issues were also noted in the Green Bowl Poké card.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line has overlapping text. The delivery time ('25–35 min') collides with the delivery fee ('€0 delivery'), producing a garbled string like '25–35mindelivery'. Both values are unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the positioning of the metadata row. Use a single flex row with separators and consistent spacing so the time and fee render as separate, non-overlapping items (e.g. '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'). Remove any duplicate or absolutely positioned element.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' time badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps and slightly clips the plate image, and its placement looks inconsistent with the other cards' badges.
issues.suggestion: Align the badge placement and padding across all cards so it doesn't collide with the image content.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'Ramen' label) has low contrast against the white background, and the metadata text is small.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) and consider a slightly larger font size.
